intents.name: greeting
intents.response:
Namaste! 🙏 Welcome to the Hospital Queue Assistant. I'm here to help you with:

• **App questions** — booking tokens, checking queue status, managing appointments, and more.
• **Medical guidance** — I can point you to the right specialist based on your symptoms.

How can I help you today? Feel free to ask anything!

intents.name: thanks
intents.response: You're very welcome! 😊 I'm glad I could help. If you have any more questions — whether about the app or a health concern — feel free to ask anytime. Take care!

intents.name: goodbye
intents.response: Goodbye! Take care of yourself, and don't hesitate to come back if you have more questions. Wishing you good health! 🙏

intents.name: help
examples: What can you help me with?
Tell me what you can do
intents.response:
I'm your Hospital Queue Assistant. Here is what I can help you with:

**App & Queue:**
• Booking, cancelling, or rescheduling tokens
• Understanding queue status and wait times
• Finding doctors and hospitals
• Notifications and profile management
• Troubleshooting app issues

**Medical Guidance:**
• Pointing you to the right specialist based on your symptoms
• Emergency guidance for urgent situations
• General health information

Just type your question naturally — for example, *"How do I cancel my token?"* or *"I have a headache, which doctor should I see?"* I'll do my best to help!

intents.name: bot_info
intents.response:
I'm the **Hospital Queue Assistant** — an AI-powered chatbot built for the Hospital Queue Management App. I'm designed to help patients in Nepal navigate the app and get quick guidance about health concerns.

I can answer questions about booking appointments, managing your queue tokens, and provide general medical guidance by routing you to the right specialist.

**Important:** I am not a doctor. For any medical concern, please always consult a qualified healthcare professional. For emergencies, call an ambulance (102 / 101) immediately.

intents.name: fallback
examples: I don't know what to ask
intents.response:
I'm sorry, I didn't quite understand that. I'm best at answering questions about:

• **Using the app** — bookings, tokens, queue status, finding doctors
• **Medical guidance** — which specialist to see for your symptoms

Could you rephrase your question? For example, try *"How do I book a token?"* or *"I have a fever, which doctor should I see?"*

If you need help with something urgent, type **"help"** to see everything I can do.
